title: Task Packet
description: A structured task definition that flows through the orchestration pipeline

created_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp when the task was created

updated_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of last state change

status.description: Current state in the pipeline state machine

title.description: Short imperative title set by the Architect

goals.description: What needs to be accomplished (set by Architect)

success_criteria.description: Verifiable conditions for task completion (used by Reviewer)

revision_count.description: Number of times the task has been sent back for revision

max_revisions.description: Maximum allowed revisions before the task is failed

branch_name.description: Git branch created for this task

pr_url.description: GitHub pull request URL (set after approval)

failure_reason.description: Reason for failure (only present if status=failed)
